settings.hero_body: Blank shelves and unfamiliar corners become a little more personal with things you love. Bring eight colorful companions into the next chapter, whether it is your move or someone else's.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_title: Give the new place some personality.
settings.final_body: Bring all eight into the room you are making your own.
settings.moods_title: Eight familiar faces for somewhere new.
settings.moods_body: The complete set comes with every design pictured.
settings.personality_title: The first corner that feels like home.
settings.personality_body: A bedside table, a bookcase or a new desk can be the crew's starting point. Arrange them together while the rest of the room comes into focus.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
settings.personality_eyebrow: The first corner that feels like home.
